replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
http://pastebin.com/vsKvKbzb

Here's an XML I made with the latest in modules - use it as a template for when you need to build some maps. I can even help you do some as well. The "Checks" system is similar to OCN's "Filters" system.

Just to note, there isn't any "apply" region types. You'll have to reference everything with id="..."

This is much faster and much better than the apply thingy.

Here's an example.

<regions>
    <join id="red">
        <cuboid min="..." max="..."/>
    </join>
</regions>
 

Now say you wanna use that in the Zones thingy.

<zones>
    <zone region="red">
        <message>^c^lThou cannot build within this region! The king will not be slighted!</message>
    </zone>
</zones>

Dere ya go baby, dere ya go!

So, if you want some blocks to not get destroyed by TNT damage then go to OCN map repo and use Boombox's filter template for it.

It's always useful to cross reference everything just to make sure.
